a3095d9729: Pop music began with the blues, and over a hundred years it turned the whole world's music upside down and blended it together. In the 1950s Taiwan took in a great deal of American pop culture and later became a centre of Mandarin pop, yet Chinese-language songwriting materials have always been scarce. This handbook organises songwriting into a system, hoping to help students clear up their questions about the craft.

a01cda5efa: Students often ask me, "Leo, how do I write a song?" Writing a song isn't hard. What's hard is building sharp powers of observation in daily life, and training yourself to record things faster and more efficiently. Hardest of all is carrying that feeling, that moment of being moved, across whole into the listener's ears, and even their heart.
013ed7fd23: Think of writing as input and output: news, conversations, travel and a lovely melody are all inputs. Once information enters your mind and is interpreted, analysed, sorted and arranged, out come the words and melodies we need. Imitating the songwriters you love, finding your direction in their work and then developing a style of your own is the safest way into songwriting.
